retained_setup_failures: The first exported configuration retained generated network_spec metadata; the strict input schema rejected it before fitting.

The corrected JSON configuration exposed scientific numeric literals being parsed as YAML strings; commit a2a0f06 fixes JSON parsing with a regression test. No fit or data-policy change occurred in either setup failure.
limitations: One epoch, 13 updates, one seed, 202 source train reals; not a full-server campaign.
Both adapted models had prior MFFI fake exposure. Validation helped select the original HF checkpoint.
Paired image-group intervals are conditional, not across-seed or identity-adjusted uncertainty.
Only the mixed arm was prescribed; no parameter search or target fitting followed.
selection_scope: Director 017 prescribed the mixed source-only follow-up from earlier source-forgetting evidence; no reopening or modification of the completed frozen min-test candidates.
